items_full.label: C300 · Bahamas · 1984 · 25 cents · BSD

payload.question: Numista N#9352 (Bahamas 25 cents 1974-1989, KM#63.1) lists 1984 only as a Franklin Mint proof (1,036 struck), with no circulation coins dated 1984 (uCoin agrees). C300 may be a proof from a 1984 set, or its year may be misread. Check the year and the finish when its photo arrives (found by Gemini, HW-gemini-value-20261015-1).

record.design: obverse coat of arms of the Bahamas · COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS · FORWARD, UPWARD, ONWARD TOGETHER · reverse Bahamian native sloop under sail · TWENTYFIVE CENTS · Arnold Machin

items_full.label: MX 20 pesos (MX.X.20-pesos)
C253 · Jamaica · 1993 · 10 cents · JMD

payload.story: A 1993 10-cent coin from Jamaica. One side shows the coat of arms of Jamaica. A crocodile sits on top. Two Taino people hold the shield. The shield has a cross with pineapples on it. The coin also says JAMAICA, TEN CENTS, and 1993. It also says the motto OUT OF MANY, ONE PEOPLE. The coin is made of steel with a thin coat of nickel on it.

items_full.label: C257 · Mexico · 1967 · 20 centavos · MXP

payload.story: A 1967 20-centavo coin from Mexico. The front shows the coat of arms of Mexico. The back shows the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan. Two volcanoes stand behind it. Their names are Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl. A liberty cap shines above the pyramid. The back also has a big 20, the word CENTAVOS, the date 1967, and the Mo mint mark. The coin is made of brass. The brass is 95% copper and 5% zinc.

record.metal: bronze · 10.00 g · 28.5 mm · reeded · circulated · white 2×2 staple flip
record.specs: thickness unknown · coin alignment · same Teotihuacan type as C244
record.design: reverse Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan · Popocatépetl & Iztaccíhuatl · radiant Phrygian cap · big 20 · CENTAVOS · date · Mo · national arms obverse
